projectName.description: The official and descriptive name of the software project.

version.description: The current version of the project, typically following Semantic Versioning (e.g., 1.0.0).

isPublic.description: Indicates if the project's source code or access is publicly available.

teamSize.description: The total number of individuals actively working on this project.

technologies.description: A list of primary programming languages, frameworks, or significant tools utilized in the project.

manager.description: Information about the primary individual responsible for project oversight.

contact.description: Alternative ways to reach the project manager.

startDate.description: The official commencement date of the project.

status.description: The current phase or state of the project lifecycle.

projects.description: A list of interconnected sub-projects or distinct modules within this larger project.

items.description: Detailed information for a specific sub-project or module.

id.description: A unique identifier for the sub-project, often automatically generated.

budget.description: The allocated financial budget for this sub-project in US Dollars.

lead.description: The name of the individual leading this specific sub-project.

tasks.description: Important tasks or milestones for this sub-project.

title: Software Project Metadata
description: Comprehensive metadata for managing a software project, designed for a user-friendly interface.
